name: middleleap-loom
description: The Loom — MiddleLeap's method for building regulated software with AI: a gated discovery harness, an autonomous delivery loop with human four-eyes merge, always-on guardrails, the machinery to adopt it in any repository, and the CLAUDE.md authoring and code-review kit it runs on. Installs the UAE banking, UAE Open Finance and Meridian Trust demo plugins with it. Proven end-to-end on a UAE Open Finance back office.
